fields.label: Overview Description
fields.name: cc_overview_description
fields.default_value:
Connecting Communities (CC) is a platform that connects infrastructure, services, and communities.

The idea is simple: start with reliable Internet, then bring useful services closer to the people who need them. By connecting technology, local access points, and specialised services, CC helps turn connectivity into practical opportunities for everyday life.
